name: Initial Access — New RDP User→Host Pair (Remote Interactive Logon)
description: First-ever RDP (Type 10) logon of a given user to a given host in the last 14 days. Low severity on its own (seed activity through a shared gateway is common) but correlates with later spray/Kerberoast/lateral movement in the multi-stage rule to elevate.
note:
### Investigation
1. Expected for this user to RDP this host?
2. Correlate source.ip and subsequent privileged/lateral activity (multi-stage rule).
### Tuning
Suppression via new_terms 14d window; a busy admin will only alert on genuinely new destinations.
author: raadabujaish
false_positives: Users legitimately accessing a new server for the first time (expected background rate; low severity by design).
query: event.code:"4624" and winlog.event_data.LogonType:"10" and source.ip:* and not source.ip:"::1"
